summary.name: 即梦AI (JiMeng AI)
summary.one_liner: 即梦AI is a Chinese AI creative platform for AI image generation, AI video generation (text/image to video), and an online canvas for editing images, with a membership subscription page.
use_cases: generate short video clips from text or images
edit images with inpainting and outpainting on a canvas
remove objects or cut out backgrounds from images
compare membership tiers for AI video generation
browse an AI art creation community for inspiration
summary.what_it_does: The page describes AI video generation where a short text prompt or an image produces a video clip, and AI painting for image creation. It also advertises an all-in-one canvas that combines AI collage generation with local repainting, one-click expansion, object removal and cutout. Multiple layers can be edited on one canvas. Most of the page is a pricing table of membership tiers (annual, quarterly, monthly and one-time plans), listing monthly credit allowances, Seedance 2.0 VIP channel access, watermark removal, 4K upscaling and per-second video prices. The listing describes it as offering 2K high-definition art and shot generation.
notable: Text and image to video generation with Seedance 2.0 VIP channel access
Multi-layer AI canvas with local repaint, one-click outpainting, object removal and cutout
Membership tiers with monthly credit allowances, watermark removal, 4K/8K upscaling, and an API service option
Built-in community for sharing AI creations
caveats: Paid membership tiers unlock fuller features; the base tier still has a Seedance 2.0 VIP channel but only standard generation channel, and watermark removal requires a paid plan
Several promotional prices and bonus credits are time-limited (page references 10月13日-10月29日) and some free image generation is valid only until 2026.11.06
Pricing is in Chinese yuan (¥) and the page is in Chinese; API usage credits are sold separately from membership credits
